lifecycle: LOCAL CANDIDATE — VALIDATED — NOT PUSHED — NOT REVIEWED — NOT MERGED — NOT PERSISTENTLY APPLIED

extensions: Two shared control files only: separate sequence-6 candidate lifecycle with unchanged five-migration foundation
Exactly one read-only SECURITY DEFINER/STABLE public.has_manage_attorney_verification_scope(uuid, boolean) with the user-approved caller and scope semantics

local_validation.migration_integrity: all five historical SHA-256 digests unchanged
local_validation.scope_audit: only authorized P1-004 files and the two explicitly approved shared control files
local_validation.sql_static: bounded SQL structure/helper/policy/grant checks passed; no standalone PostgreSQL parser installed and no dependency added; actual PostgreSQL DDL and runtime assertions passed inside rollback

validation_batch.mechanism: One SQL batch: BEGIN; anonymous validation block with caught-error subtransaction; return in-transaction evidence; explicit ROLLBACK. Read-only probes verified transaction continuity, evidence delivery before ROLLBACK, rollback of local settings, and error-handler completion. No persistent migration/apply operation.

runs.purpose: Final complete suite with T2 current-basis assertion after replacement of restored association.

validation_batch.timestamp_semantics: rolled_back_at records client acknowledgment of completed rollback batch; restored_at records independent restoration verification.

candidate_fingerprint.scope: nine P1-004 relations and one approved helper; association column privileges captured separately

data.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_manage_attorney_verification_scope(required_jurisdiction uuid, allow_any_jurisdiction boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.capability_grants as g
    join public.users as u on u.id = g.user_id
    where u.auth_user_id = auth.uid()
      and g.capability_code = 'manage_attorney_verification'
      and g.granted_at <= statement_timestamp()
      and g.revoked_at is null
      and (g.expires_at is null or g.expires_at > statement_timestamp())
      and g.resource_scope is null
      and (allow_any_jurisdiction is true or g.jurisdiction_id is null
           or g.jurisdiction_id = required_jurisdiction)
  );
$function$
data.name: has_manage_attorney_verification_scope

helper_contract: No caller/user or capability-code parameter. auth.uid() maps to public.users. Only live manage_attorney_verification grants qualify. NULL required jurisdiction is global-only unless any-jurisdiction mode, which policies use solely for inactive Practice Areas. Existing capability_grants ACL unchanged.
historical_writer_contract: Every persisted consequential evaluation independently identifies each relied-upon verification_evidence.id and direct professional-record IDs. Association IDs alone are insufficient. T1 byte-for-byte unchanged after association replacement and deletion; a later consequential evaluation is a new coexisting T2.
final_commit_gate: A final local candidate commit is permitted only after the validated phase and all local/evidence checks pass. Commit identity is reported after creation; no self-referential commit hash is embedded.

file_integrity.self_digest: The SHA-256 of this evidence file is reported separately at delivery to avoid a self-referential digest.
